name: Agalinis
look_here_first: Measure the pedicel from flowering branch to calyx on several intact flowers, then inspect calyx lobe length relative to the tube. Long pedicels with very short calyx lobes favor A. edwardsiana; very short pedicels with conspicuous calyx lobes favor A. heterophylla.
shared_genus_traits: Slender green hemiparasitic herbs with narrow leaves.
Bilaterally symmetric tubular corollas and small calyces.
Branch angle and pink-purple flower color overlap and are not sufficient for identification.

species_comparison_matrix.edwardsiana: Relatively long, reported up to about 30 mm
Very short relative to calyx tube

species_comparison_matrix.heterophylla: Narrow leaves; occasionally three-parted lower leaves

quick_comparison_steps: Find intact flowers with stalk attachment visible.
Measure pedicels on several flowers with millimeter scale.
Photograph calyx side-on and compare lobes with tube length.
Check lower leaves as supporting evidence; do not identify from color alone.
overlap_and_cautions: Both species can have narrow leaves, purple flowers and right-angle branching.
A single damaged or immature flower may give misleading pedicel measurements.
Other Agalinis species may occur; do not force an identification if measured characters disagree.
Both canonical species retain unresolved target-zone range labels.

local_source_pool_lookalikes.look_for: Compare intact pedicels and calyx lobes before naming.
Use calyx and pedicel measurements rather than leaf narrowness.
Compare corolla form, calyx and bracts; green hemiparasitic habit is not species-specific.

diagnostic_photo_checklist.shot: Paired flowering pedicels with millimeter scale
Matched calyx side macros with tube and lobe labels
Lower leaf sequences on both plants
diagnostic_photo_checklist.character: Occasional three-parted lower leaves in heterophylla

diagnostic_photo_checklist.shot: Whole flowering branch including stalk origins

comparison_cards.title: Pedicel: the flower stalk, not the branch
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Compare several side-on flower stalks measured from branch to calyx: A. edwardsiana up to ~30 mm; A. heterophylla ~1.6–3.2 mm.
photo_requirements: Matched millimeter-scaled pedicel side views, both species
comparison_cards.caution: Neither installed image proves this measurement.

comparison_cards.title: Calyx: lobes versus tube
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Heterophylla calyx lobes are conspicuous, about 3–6 mm in a regional flora; edwardsiana lobes are very short relative to tube.
photo_requirements: Matched calyx tube/lobe side macros, both species
comparison_cards.caution: Absolute edwardsiana lobe measurements require diagnostic review.
